confidence_notes: Numbeo showed Rethymno meal, coffee and beer prices; BudgetYourTrip showed median hotel prices and KAYAK showed a 3-star average. Hostel prices and current aggregated cocktail and wine prices were not verified, so those anchors are rough; drink estimates use their relationship to local draft beer. The hotel sources do not clearly establish annual tax- and fee-inclusive prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Rethymno-specific price data was available.
